items.title: Wheat Flakes in a Dish
items.alt: A pale blue scalloped bowl holds golden rolled cereal flakes beside a silver spoon and ripe wheat heads.
items.description: A pale blue scalloped bowl holds golden rolled cereal flakes beside a silver spoon and ripe wheat heads. Use this breakfast still life on a personal meal-planning page or cereal vocabulary sheet.

items.title: Sifting Wheat Flour
items.alt: Two hands with complete cream sleeve cuffs sift flour through a round wooden sieve into a clear mixing bowl beside a wheat head.
items.description: Two hands with complete cream sleeve cuffs sift flour through a round wooden sieve into a clear mixing bowl beside a wheat head. The falling flour gives a personal baking-process layout a clear action.

items.title: Mixing Wheat Dough
items.alt: A deep brown mixing bowl holds rough dough and a wooden spoon, with flour on its rim and golden wheat heads beside it.
items.description: A deep brown mixing bowl holds rough dough and a wooden spoon, with flour on its rim and golden wheat heads beside it. Leave space beside the bowl for your own mixing-stage notes.

items.title: Round Bread and Wheat
items.alt: A round loaf with a single long score rests on a folded striped linen cloth beside two ripe wheat heads.
items.description: A round loaf with a single long score rests on a folded striped linen cloth beside two ripe wheat heads. Use the complete loaf as a small centerpiece in a personal baking design.

items.title: Sliced Bread with Wheat Grain
items.alt: A rectangular wheat loaf has two cut slices leaning against it beside loose kernels and a ripe wheat head.
items.description: A rectangular wheat loaf has two cut slices leaning against it beside loose kernels and a ripe wheat head. The visible crumb and cut slices suit a bread vocabulary or meal-planning card.

items.title: Pasta Nests and Wheat
items.alt: Two dry ribbon pasta nests sit beside one golden wheat head and several loose kernels.
items.description: Two dry ribbon pasta nests sit beside one golden wheat head and several loose kernels. Place the dry pasta beside your own notes about foods made from grain.
